record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.original_question: How does the graph complex act on the space of deformation-quantisation star-products, especially under gauge transformations ⋆⇄⋆′, when the leading Poisson bi-vector in a Kontsevich star-product ⋆ = × + ħ{·,·}_P + o(ħ) is shifted by a graph-generated symmetry Q(P)=O→r(γ)(P) to P+εQ(P)+o(ε)? Can this action be described explicitly and illustrated by examples?

evidence.quote: Problem 17. Describe and illustrate by examples the action of graph complex on the set of star-products (in particular, in the context of their gauge transformations ⋆ ⇄ ⋆′) whenever the Poisson bi-vector P in the leading deformation term ħP of ⋆ = × + ħ {·, ·}_P + o(ħ) is shifted by a symmetry Q(P) = O→r(γ ∈ ker[•−•, ·])(P) to ħP + εQ(ħP) + o(ε).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $P$ be a Poisson bi-vector on a smooth manifold $M$, and let
$$\star \;=\; \times \;+\; \hbar\,\{\cdot,\cdot\}_P \;+\; o(\hbar)$$
be a Kontsevich formal deformation-quantisation star-product on $C^\infty(M)[[\hbar]]$ whose leading deformation term is the Poisson bracket associated with $P$. Two such star-products $\star$ and $\star'$ are called gauge-equivalent if there exists a formal differential operator $T = \mathrm{id} + \hbar T_1 + \hbar^2 T_2 + \cdots$ such that
$$T(f \star g) \;=\; T(f) \star' T(g) \qquad \text{for all } f,g \in C^\infty(M)[[\hbar]].$$

Let $\mathsf{GC}$ denote Kontsevich's graph complex of (un)oriented graphs with the vertex-expansion differential $[\bullet\!-\!\bullet,\,\cdot\,]$. For each cocycle $\gamma \in \ker[\bullet\!-\!\bullet,\,\cdot\,]$, the orient-and-realise map produces a multivector field $Q(P) := \mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma)(P)$ that is a symmetry of the Poisson structure, in the sense that $P + \varepsilon\,Q(P) + o(\varepsilon)$ is again Poisson modulo $\varepsilon^2$.

Problem. Describe explicitly the induced action of the graph complex $\mathsf{GC}$ on the set of Kontsevich star-products. Specifically:

1. Given a graph cocycle $\gamma$ and a star-product $\star$ as above, define and compute an infinitesimal deformation $\star \mapsto \star + \varepsilon\,\delta_\gamma(\star) + o(\varepsilon)$ whose leading-order Poisson bi-vector is shifted from $\hbar P$ to $\hbar P + \varepsilon\,Q(\hbar P) + o(\varepsilon)$.

2. Determine how this action interacts with gauge equivalence $\star \rightleftarrows \star'$: in particular, decide whether gauge-equivalent star-products are sent to gauge-equivalent star-products, and identify the induced action on gauge-equivalence classes.

3. Illustrate the construction with explicit examples (e.g. using small graph cocycles such as the tetrahedron $\gamma_3$ or the pentagon-wheel $\gamma_5$) on concrete Poisson manifolds.
artifact.category_tag: Kontsevich graph complex and deformation quantization
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of explicitly describing the action of Kontsevich's graph complex on star-products and on their gauge equivalence classes appears to remain open. Related developments include software (gcaops) computing the graph-complex action on Poisson structures, and theses/papers describing the action on Poisson structures and their formal deformations, but a complete explicit description at the level of star-products including gauge-transformation behaviour, with worked examples, has not been established as a finished theory.

status_evidence.title: The action of Kontsevich's graph complex on Poisson structures
status_evidence.snippet: Thesis describing the action of the graph complex on Poisson structures and their deformations.
status_evidence.claim: Active research describes the graph-complex action on Poisson structures, with the lift to star-products and gauge classes still being investigated.

status_evidence.title: gcaops — Python package implementing the action of Kontsevich's graph complex(es) on Poisson structures
status_evidence.snippet: Software package for computing graph-complex actions on Poisson structures.
status_evidence.claim: Computational tools exist for graph-complex action on Poisson structures, indicating an explicit description at the star-product level remains a target of ongoing work.

status_evidence.title: Poisson Bracket, Deformed Bracket and Gauge Group Actions in Kontsevich Deformation Quantization
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the relationship between the Poisson bracket, the deformed bracket, and gauge group actions in Kontsevich's deformation quantization.
status_evidence.claim: Gauge group actions on Kontsevich star-products are studied, but a fully explicit description of how graph-complex symmetries act on gauge classes remains incomplete.
